column5: Criterion 2 requires the named repo checked; an inherited GIT_DIR defeating -C is a defect.
Text only names a function and line range; no defect stated.
Ticket covers pinned in-flight runs, not recorded paths into main that the merge deletes; fix chose mitigation.
Criterion 3 requires skill-refs to check the new form; the regex accepts stage.sh wrongly.
Dangling lib refs must not pass; the matcher wrongly accepts top-level scripts and .bak suffixes.

Direction leaves files as they are; replacing the host device tree contradicts it.

Text reads "not provided"; no defect is stated.
Sibling inspection failures return 2; consistency is the one sane answer, so this branch must not report success.
A race with the finish watcher; one sane answer is to treat the already-closed placement as settled.

Stale sentence: the document still describes a raw kill while the code writes three-line pidfiles.

Ticket silent on drives of single-copy surfaces; asks to restore what the previous round's reword made conditional.
